PSP bundled assets provisioned individually without overwrite, repairing BusyBox cp -n skipping the existing empty destination directory
Faster 0.1.9.3 Dreamcast renderer, all emulator core payloads, save-state formats, other systems and one-second Menu-hold controls retained
validation: Burst-buffer tests, timed PCM consumption through 100 ms render bursts and empty-audio calls without underruns; existing SNES/PS1 audio continuity; local/offline Studio centre/UMD geometry checks; SoulCalibur existing-state restore and PCM/video; six mixed DC/PSP launches and state round trips; full Slot Menu-hold exit; actual BusyBox asset-copy regression; KMS/DRM executable and dependency checks; ZIP CRC and SD read-back.

graphics_tradeoff: The existing 0.1.9.3 lightweight transparency/shadow settings are unchanged.
